title: COMPUTER AIDED DESIGN
description: Introduction to the Adobe Creative Suite: Illustrator and Photoshop. Instruction in drawing, image editing, flat illustrations and textile design.
registration_restrictions:
Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Design & Innovation Management (052)
  • Pre-Apparel (453)
  • Pre-Interiors (454)
  • Art and Design (478)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component. Required laptop/software.
